read.passage: My name is Omar. I am nine years old. Last weekend, my family visited my grandmother in Abha. It was cold there, so I wore my jacket. Grandma made a big lunch with rice and chicken. After lunch, my sister and I played football in the garden. I scored three goals! In the evening, we drank tea and ate dates. It was a great day.

qs.q: Why did Omar wear his jacket?
options: Because his grandmother gave it to him.

qs.q: What did Omar do after lunch?

aloud: My grandfather walked to the market and bought some fresh dates.
We played in the garden, and then we watched a funny film.

speak.prompt: What did you do last weekend? Tell me about it.
speak.expect: At A1 (GSE 26-29) the learner can give a short answer of 2-4 simple sentences about a familiar personal topic (family, places, activities). They use basic past simple forms, some of them correct (went, played, ate), possibly with errors on less common verbs. They link ideas with 'and', 'then' or 'because'. Vocabulary is from familiar Movers topics such as family, food, places and sports. Some pauses and hesitations are expected. Pronunciation is understandable with effort, and the learner may need the examiner to rephrase or prompt with questions such as 'Who did you go with?' The learner cannot yet keep a longer narrative going without help.
